consumer: A detection/targeting check asking 'can the avatar see this specific monster right now?' that EVALUATES the engine-computed yes/no from Creature::sees, not a render decision.
scope: pairwise avatar-as-observer visibility against one specific target monster (not a map region, not inventory)
decisive_source: src/creature.cpp::Creature::sees — computes a boolean of whether one creature can see another from range, light, line of sight, concealment, crouch/hide-place and night-invisibility branches.
divergence: A monster in plain range and LOS but standing in a hide-place / crouched behind concealment (or night-invisible): Creature::sees returns false, while a raw range+LOS re-derivation that omits the concealment/crouch/night branches would wrongly report it visible.
